description: EasyGSH-DB_TDKW: Überflutungsdauer (1996-2015) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesanstalt für Wasserbau. The average duration of flooding for the 12 nautical mile limit for the years 1996-2015. The duration of flooding is the time that an area is covered with water during a tide. A detailed description of the analysis modes can be found in the BAWiki ( Parameters des Water Level). Coverage: Bundesanstalt für Wasserbau. The portal shows the English title as "EasyGSH-DB _TDKW: Flood duration (1996-2015)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Bundesanstalt für Wasserbau. Its keywords include opendata, Bundeswasserstraßen-ID: 7000, Wasserstraßen und Gewässer, MDI-DE_Ozeanographie, mittlere Ueberflutungsdauer, Analysedaten. The listing shows 1 download or service links in GML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
